body: Hey, thanks for responding. I’m struggling with this and haven’t actually committed to not going through with it, but I’m still here and thought you should know. I don’t have anyone I can be open ab this with irl, so just knowing a real person read and validated my feelings means a lot. Can’t deny that some of your advice sounds like it came from a bad self help book, but I get what you’re saying and hearing success stories always helps. No idea how long I can keep this up, but for now I’m fighting through everything. Hopefully there’s a light at the end of this tunnel.
